title: Türkiye to Host 14th Türkiye-US Naval Cooperation Meeting
excerpt: Türkiye's defence ministry says the 14th Türkiye-US Naval Forces Cooperation Meeting will be held on 16-18 November, as a NATO maritime unmanned systems meeting wraps up in Istanbul.
rank_math_title: Türkiye hosts 14th Türkiye-US naval meeting | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: The 14th Türkiye-US Naval Forces Cooperation Meeting will be held in Türkiye on 16-18 November, as a NATO maritime unmanned systems meeting ends in Istanbul.
